title: A pseudoenzyme sensor of trehalose-6-phosphate directly represses the metabolic integrator SnRK1 in plants
title_zh: 一种伪酶传感器直接抑制植物中代谢整合因子SnRK1的三萜六磷酸
abstract: Trehalose-6-phosphate (T6P) is a central metabolic signal linking sugar availability to plant growth, carbon utilization, and productivity, yet its sensing and signaling mechanisms remain elusive. Using chemical biology and functional approaches, we identify the noncatalytic pseudoenzyme Class-II T6P synthase (TPS-II) as a T6P sensor in Arabidopsis. In the apo state, TPS-II dimerizes to form an autoinhibitory inter-subunit interaction. T6P binding to the N-terminal TPS-like domain triggers a conformational change that releases the C-terminal domain, enabling interaction with the central metabolic integrator SNF1-related protein kinase 1 (SnRK1) to repress its kinase activity. Loss of TPS-II genes activates catabolic and stress-responsive programs while suppressing anabolic gene expression, consistent with constitutive SnRK1 activity. Conservation of this T6P-TPS-II-SnRK1 signaling axis throughout the plant kingdom highlights its fundamental role in coupling carbon availability to metabolic homeostasis. These findings resolve a long-standing question in sugar signaling and provide a framework for improving crop carbon-use efficiency.
abstract_zh: 三萜六磷酸（T6P）是将糖可用性与植物生长、碳利用和产量联系起来的核心代谢信号，但其感知和信号机制仍不清楚。通过化学生物学和功能学方法，我们发现非催化性伪酶类II型T6P合成酶（TPS‑II）是拟南芥中的T6P传感器。在无配体状态下，TPS‑II二聚化形成自抑制的亚基间相互作用。T6P与N端TPS样结构域结合触发构象变化，释放C端结构域，使其能够与中心代谢整合因子SNF1相关蛋白激酶1（SnRK1）相互作用，从而抑制其激酶活性。缺失TPS‑II基因会激活分解代谢和应激响应程序，同时抑制合成基因表达，符合持续活跃的SnRK1。该T6P‑TPS‑II‑SnRK1信号轴在整个植物界的保守性突显其在将碳可用性与代谢稳态耦合中的基本作用。这些发现解答了糖信号长期未解的问题，并为提高作物碳利用效率提供了框架。
